title: PCE强到要加息：债市却押注暂停，100基点预期砍半
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I just, you'll take on the data and then you'll take on the market.
segments.zh: 你先看数据，再看市场反应。

segments.en: Do you think this market will provide a forward look to what might be in the data in months to come?
segments.zh: 你觉得市场会提前反映未来几个月数据可能的情况吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I think the market is trying to price. What is 2027 going to look like?
segments.zh: 是的，我认为市场正在试图定价。2027年会是什么样子？

segments.en: And certainly this is back with looking data, particularly the third quarter data.
segments.zh: 当然，这又回到了看数据，尤其是第三季度数据。

segments.en: I think that the PC numbers are probably just strong enough that it certainly means that the Fed is going to hike in December.
segments.zh: 我认为个人消费支出数据可能足够强劲，这当然意味着美联储将在12月加息。

segments.en: But the important thing from that is what will then signal after that and what the bond market's certainly telling you is that look, the chances of 100 basis point of rate hikes
segments.zh: 但重要的是之后会发出什么信号，债券市场明确告诉你的是，100个基点加息的可能性

segments.en: has come down quite substantially. And we're looking at another 25 to 50 basis points and then a long pause.
segments.zh: 已经大幅下降。我们预计再加25到50个基点，然后长期暂停。

segments.en: And that's why you have, like you noted, John, that the belly has been outperforming.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么正如你指出的，约翰，中期债券表现优异。

segments.en: In fact, just the last this week, the five years outperform by 10 basis points on the curve.
segments.zh: 事实上，就在本周，五年期在曲线上跑赢10个基点。

segments.en: And that's not unprecedented, but that's pretty rare and a sign that the market's starting to think that, hey, in 2028, 2029, we're going to have a pretty bad economy.
segments.zh: 这并非史无前例，但相当罕见，表明市场开始认为，嘿，2028、2029年经济会相当糟糕。

segments.en: Are you talking about that signal? Fed chat doesn't want to provide it.
segments.zh: 你说的那个信号？美联储沟通并不想提供。

segments.en: We do get a dot plot in a few weeks' time. Ira, what were you looking for in the forecast from this Federal Reserve outside of what the chairman might say?
segments.zh: 几周后我们会看到点阵图。Ira，除了主席可能说的话，你关注美联储预测中的哪些内容？

segments.en: Yeah, it could be our last dot plot, John, depending on what they decided to do in January.
segments.zh: 是的，John，这可能是我最后一次点阵图，取决于他们一月份的决定。

segments.en: But yeah, I expected this version of views to tighten up a bit, especially for 2027.
segments.zh: 但我确实预计这版观点会略微收紧，尤其是对2027年。
